# discord_guild_settings (Resource)

Manages settings on an existing Discord guild. The guild itself is not created or destroyed by this resource; deleting it from Terraform leaves the guild's current configuration in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_guild_settings" "main" {
  guild_id                      = "123456789012345678"
  name                          = "My Community"
  description                   = "A friendly place"
  verification_level            = 2
  default_message_notifications = 1
  explicit_content_filter       = 2
  afk_timeout                   = 300
  premium_progress_bar_enabled  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `guild_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the guild. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `afk_channel_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the AFK voice channel.
- `afk_timeout` (Number) AFK timeout in seconds (60, 300, 900, 1800, 3600).
- `community` (Boolean) Whether the guild's Community feature is enabled. Toggling this includes or excludes `COMMUNITY` in the guild's `features` while preserving all other features. Enabling Community also requires `rules_channel_id` and `public_updates_channel_id` to be set, `verification_level` of at least 1 (LOW), and `explicit_content_filter` of 2 (ALL_MEMBERS); set those in the same resource.
- `default_message_notifications` (Number) Default message notification level (0 all messages, 1 only mentions).
- `description` (String) Guild description (community guilds).
- `explicit_content_filter` (Number) Explicit content filter level (0-2).
- `name` (String) Guild name.
- `preferred_locale` (String) Preferred locale of a community guild.
- `premium_progress_bar_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the boost progress bar is enabled.
- `public_updates_channel_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the public updates channel (community guilds).
- `rules_channel_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the rules channel (community guilds).
- `system_channel_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the system messages channel.
- `verification_level` (Number) Verification level (0-4).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Guild settings are imported using the guild snowflake ID.
terraform import discord_guild_settings.main 123456789012345678
```
